Stride / Step Review

First-pass SLAM head-motion step proxy. Use the downward video to check whether each detected side-to-side peak matches a real step.

How to read this: each step marker is estimated between neighboring lateral head-sway extrema. The length shown is horizontal path traveled between estimated step events, and the rolling average uses your chosen last-N previous detected steps across the trial.
Important: this is a head/Aria SLAM proxy, not confirmed foot-contact stride length. Please validate with the downward view.
